title: This Animal Has 1,306 Legs, No Eyes, and Lives Deep Underground

scenes.text: This animal has 1,306 legs, and it has no eyes.
A millipede from Western Australia. It lives in the dark, up to 60 meters underground.
Until 2020, the record was 750 legs, held by a California millipede.
Then two small ones turned up in drill holes dug for mineral exploration.
Researchers lowered traps 60 meters down and caught five adults. Females have 1,306 legs. Males, just 818.
And the body is barely a millimeter wide. A thread with more than a thousand legs.

description:
This Australian millipede has 1,306 legs and no eyes, and it lives deep underground.
It was found in drill holes dug during mineral exploration in Western Australia, beating the old record of 750 legs.
Could you live with no eyes? Tell us below.
first_comment: Its name means 'the Persephone's thousand feet' after the queen of the underworld. Would you want to meet it in the dark?
